description: Gromowa Strzala, a thunderstone, a big dark flint arrowhead as big as a man thrown down from the clouds by the thunder god, chipped sharp edges, crackling with bright blue-white lightning, glowing cracks, a fierce glowing eye in its middle, flying point forward, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the arrowhead alone, no ground, no background, the whole arrowhead inside the picture
